inventory_subtitle: Count products and confirm physical stock.
receive_plan_hint: Quantities contain the remaining saved plan: planned minus already received. Adjust them to actual production; zero skips a line.
saved_all: Saved successfully. Accepted lines are locked against another submission.
partial_result: Partially saved. Check each product result. Successful lines will not be submitted again.
conflict: Data changed while you were working. Reload and count the product again.
retry_hint: Result not confirmed. Retry saving; the same operation identifier will be used.
invalid_input: Enter valid quantities for the selected products.
failed: Could not save. Reload data and try again.
title: Product inventory count
subtitle: Count products manually and save actual quantities.
snapshot_hint: The list shows stock when opened. Only products with a confirmed nonzero balance are visible by default. Confirming a count means the indicated quantities have been physically counted.
unit_hint: Enter whole-product equivalents, e.g. 2 halves = 1 product. An empty field is not zero. Reservations are not deducted from the physical count.
shift_required: Select the employee using this tablet before saving stock.
unavailable: Could not load stock. Reload data.
unsupported: Weighted products are not supported yet.
empty: No products assigned to this shop.
hidden_hint: Zero and uncounted products hidden by default
show_all_hint: Use the switch below to show the full list and start the first count.
